official_title: 1999/168/EC: Council Decision of 25 January 1999 adopting a specific programme for research, technological development and demonstration on a user-friendly information society (1998 to 2002)

institution_roles.evidence_locator: Act heading, adoption clause and signature, PDF pages 1–4
Original Official Journal of the European Communities masthead

corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: Dedicated research priorities fund intelligent medical systems, language understanding, knowledge extraction, intelligent assistants and learner modelling. These substantial precursor provisions document the transition from earlier European information-technology programmes toward later AI research priorities.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: Original specific-programme decision, separate from the FP5 framework. EUR-Lex currently labels it In force; the programme's 2002 completion does not establish legal expiry or repeal. Relevance and sector tags are editorial classifications supported by Annex II.
